name: Akitsu Kyouhei
source:
Sayane's 30 years old violin teacher.
He's a soloists who has both brains and beauty, who was once world famous violinist.
Has wife and children, with who he doesn't live. (divorce?)
His hair color changes with the seasons.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
